name: Hadamard-smoothed asym. KV + edge residual
tagline: Per-channel min-max for keys, intra-group Walsh-Hadamard rotation before per-token min-max for values, plus 1.5x FP16 residual on first/last layer.

key_hyperparams.name: residual_length
key_hyperparams.role: FP16 tail tokens (1.5x at edge layers)

key_hyperparams.name: edge_factor
key_hyperparams.role: extra residual at first / last layer

init_recovers: KIVI-style 4-bit min-max if Hadamard $H_G = I$ (no rotation)
diff_from_baseline: Extends KIVI 4-bit (per-channel keys, per-token values) by inserting an in-group Walsh-Hadamard rotation on the value tensor before min-max and dequantizing through $H_G^\top$, plus a 1.5x FP16 residual at the first and last layer.

name: Per-group log-range adaptive bitwidth
tagline: Allocate per-group bits as $b_g = b + \log_2 r_g - \overline{\log_2 r}$, water-fill back into [1,8], then min-max quantize with the group's bit count.
init_recovers: Plain per-group min-max if all $r_g$ equal (then $b_g = b$)
diff_from_baseline: Replaces KIVI's fixed-bit per-group min-max with a log-range-driven allocator that gives more bits to groups with larger dynamic range and fewer to peaky-clean groups, while keeping the average at $b$.

name: Query-importance mixed-precision + anchor tokens
tagline: Use prefill query energy to set a per-layer profile that drives per-(layer, KV-kind) bits and the size of recent + global-anchor FP16 retention windows.

key_hyperparams.name: anchor_keep base
key_hyperparams.role: global FP16 anchor tokens by importance

init_recovers: Uniform 4-bit KIVI when $p_\ell$ uniform and depth past threshold
diff_from_baseline: Generalizes KVTuner's per-layer preset by computing the bit count and FP16 window dynamically from prefill query energy, additionally retaining a small set of importance-top tokens as global anchors and choosing key axis (channel vs token) per layer by minimum quantization MSE.

name: Attention-entropy adaptive bits + top-k FP16
tagline: Compute prefill softmax-attention entropy per head; map low-entropy heads to higher bits and keep top-k attention-target positions in FP16.

key_hyperparams.name: ratio map
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of FP16 anchors per head

init_recovers: Per-head 4-bit KIVI if entropies $\bar e_h \in (2, 3]$ and ratio $\eta = 0.05$
diff_from_baseline: On top of KIVI-style per-channel/per-token min-max, runs a real prefill softmax to assign per-head bit count from attention entropy and per-(layer,head) FP16 anchor sets from per-head top-k attention targets.
